task: Port a front-end query, input or interned struct from blaze-query to blaze-memo
do: Change the attribute path `blaze_query::` to `blaze_memo::`; the call shape (`#[blaze_memo::tracked(returns(..))] fn q(db: &dyn Db, ..) -> V`, tracked impls, `#[input]`, `#[interned]`) is the same. Then: (1) the value must own no memory to drop (a compile-time error after monomorphization names it): replace Vec/Box/Arc/String/ThinVec in it with `&'db [T]` from `blaze_memo::keep_slice`/`keep_iter`/`keep_str` (or `keep` for one value) made inside the run, or with ids; (2) every argument type must be Copy + Eq + Hash + `blaze_memo::Home` (add `#[derive(blaze_memo::Home)]`, `#[home(skip)]` on fields holding no id); interned fields too; (3) `cycle_result`/`cycle_initial`/`cycle_fn` lose the `Id` parameter: `(db, args..)` and `(db, &Cycle, last, new, args..)`; (4) drop `lru`, `weigh`, `no_eq`, `scope`, `settled`, `mem_tag`, `#[set]`, `#[default]` (each refusal says what replaces it); a tracked struct becomes `#[interned]`; `Value`/`Supertype` derives go (a `Home` derive replaces what they told the engine); (5) a query whose key names no crate (homed at the session arena) may not read a crate's arena: give it a key holding the crate's id; (6) inputs are made by the driver with `X::new(&inputs, fact, fields..)` (singletons `X::set`) while it builds a snapshot, never set later; an input that holds ids of another arena needs `inputs.borrows(that_arena)`. `Debug` of an id prints fields inside `blaze_memo::attach(db, || ..)`. (7) direct engine calls map: `blaze_query::db::Id` -> `blaze_memo::Gid`, `AsId`/`FromId` -> `blaze_memo::Id` (`gid`/`from_gid`), `db::attach` -> `blaze_memo::attach`, `capture_reads` -> `blaze_memo::record`, `report_stored_read` -> `blaze_memo::read`; `replay_reads`, `DatabaseKeyIndex`, `ReadKind` have no counterpart (a hit replays by itself). A `set_x(db).to(..)` during a build (nameres and method_resolution `delta/publish.rs`) has none either: make the published value a query's result, or an input the driver makes for the next snapshot. (8) The form each of those setters takes, fixed here by target decisions 1-4 (/Volumes/Projects/blaze-int-1112-notes/target-decisions-1113.md) so no lane decides it again. The rule: a dependency crate's scopes and impl index are facts of its surface image, read in place; within the crate being built they are query results over its file images; nothing is set, nothing is maintained, and no slot is filled. The driver makes one input per dependency crate (its mapped surface image, the fact its digest) and one per file (its image) while building a snapshot. hir-def `nameres/delta/publish.rs`: `ScopeInput` (`set_scope`, `set_children`, per module) becomes, for a dependency, the module's scope and children arrays in the image, by crate-local dense id; for the crate being built, a query `module_scope(db, ModuleId) -> &'db Scope` over its file images, homed at the crate. `CrateResolution` (`set_root`, `set_modules`, `set_local`, `set_data`, `set_prelude`, `set_macro_use_prelude`, `set_session_macros`) becomes, for a dependency, the image's crate section (root module, module table, crate data, preludes, exported macros); for the crate being built, one query `crate_resolution(db, Crate)` returning arena slices (`keep_slice`). `set_records` (the resolution's read records) is no value at all: it is the read list `blaze_memo::record` returns for that query, written into its record. The write-once slots (`enter`, `ModulesSlot`, `RecordsSlot`) go: single flight on the query is the wait. hir-ty `method_resolution/delta/publish.rs` and `state.rs`: `TraitImplsSlice`, `InherentSlice` and `CandidateSlice` (`set_rows`, per (crate, trait), (crate, head) and (crate, name)) become, for a dependency, the image's impl-index arrays, sorted by the stable id of the trait, the self-type head or the name and binary-searched in place; for the crate being built, queries `trait_impls(db, Crate, TraitId)`, `inherent_impls(db, Crate, Head)` and `candidates(db, Crate, Name)` over its item images. `SliceDirectory`/`DirectorySlot` (`set_traits`, `set_heads`, `set_names`, `set_body_modules`) become the image's index key table, or a query `impl_directory(db, Crate)`. `ImplIdentities` (`set_impl_`, `set_def`) becomes the image's stable ids (a hash of path and kind) for dependencies, and ids `#[interned]` in the crate's arena for the crate being built. The maintainer (`State`, `Published::set_*`, 'set only when content changed') is deleted, not ported: the firewall is the per-fact digest in the image (decision 3), and a change drops the crate's arena (decision 4). (9) The whole-port rules (spec docs/v2/plan/design/front-end-on-memo.md, which has the counts, the hard cases and the lanes): no revisions, edges or durabilities (`$X.with_durability($D)` -> `$X` by ast-grep; every other `Durability::` argument deleted by hand; `witnessed(db, &mut v, f)` -> `f()`; `deps::key::sealed` -> the arena not being in the changed set; sealed.rs, covers and `settled =` hooks deleted); a key's home is the arena of its highest crate in dependency order (driver-assigned indices), and a key naming two unrelated crates adds the asking `Crate`; `lru`/`weigh`/`mem_tag`/`#[default]` deleted; the crate being built is served from its own image when its surface key hit, else lowered (`Serve`: served-else-lowered, signatures.rs:185/191); `db::attach` by ast-grep `blaze_query::db::attach($DB, $F)` -> `blaze_memo::attach($DB, $F)`, `with_attached_db::<D>` keeps its name in blaze_memo; tracked structs: `BlockIdLt`/`ModuleIdLt` -> `#[interned]` homed by `krate`, `DefMapPair`/`HeldRecords`/`Modules`/`ModuleScope`/`ItemBodySyntax` -> plain values of their building query (`DefMapPair` folds into `crate_resolution`); `with_steps`/`db::step` -> a hir-ty-pure task-local budget whose exhaustion unwinds as `OutOfSteps`, never memoized; `synthetic_write` -> `memo.next(&[])`; `Revision`/`nonce_and_revision` -> the snapshot epoch or deleted; persisted `db::Id.as_u32()` -> stable ids; no flag, no second path: blaze_query keeps only the `Query` trait family blaze-units uses.
why: blaze-memo replaces blaze-query under hir-def and hir-ty (audit 2026-11-13 verdict (a)); the porting lanes need the mechanical part and the six real changes in one place.
